specs.description: 1U 7010X management/access switch: 48 copper Gigabit Ethernet ports and four 1/10/25GbE SFP28 uplinks. R ordering variant; confirm the installed reversible fan orientation.
specs.notes: Manufacturer-backed model reference. Supported components and ordered default quantities do not verify an installed deployment. No measured power or saved rack budgets are created. R variant uses a reversible fan; verify actual orientation.

components.notes: Model capability: 10/100/1000 Mb/s; negotiated link rate is not recorded here. Source: https://www.arista.com/en/products/7010x-series
Supports 1/10/25 GbE with appropriate optics/cables and configuration. Cages do not imply installed transceivers. Source: https://www.arista.com/en/products/7010x-series
Management is separate from numbered data ports. Console serial and USB are not network endpoints. Source: https://www.arista.com/en/qsg-7010-series-1ru/7010-series-1ru-front-panel
Two internal load-sharing supplies, not hot-swappable PSU modules. Exact DC output/derated AC capacity is not asserted. Source: https://www.arista.com/en/products/7010x-series

custom.name: Uplinks
custom.value:
4 × SFP28 cages, 1/10/25 GbE; physical ports 49–52. Optics are separate.
Source: https://www.arista.com/en/products/7010x-series

custom.name: Management and console
custom.value:
Dedicated Ethernet management, RJ45 serial console and USB on front.
Source: https://www.arista.com/en/products/7010x-series

custom.name: Power design
custom.value:
Two internal AC supplies, 100–240 VAC, 1+1 redundancy. PSU output capacity remains unspecified.
Source: https://www.arista.com/en/products/7010x-series

custom.name: Ordered airflow variant
custom.value:
DCS-7010TX-48-R: rear-to-front airflow and dual AC power; fan module is field reversible. Confirm installed orientation.
Source: https://www.arista.com/assets/data/pdf/Datasheets/7010TX-Datasheet.pdf

custom.name: Cooling
custom.value:
One reversible field-replaceable module with two fans; verify actual airflow orientation.
Source: https://www.arista.com/en/products/7010x-series

custom.name: Dimensions (W × H × D)
custom.value:
483 × 44 × 258 mm including rack mounting width, per Quick Start Guide.
Source: https://www.arista.com/en/qsg-7010-series-1ru/7010-series-1ru-overview

custom.name: Manufacturer demand reference
custom.value:
75 W typical / 100 W maximum per Quick Start Guide. Reference only: not an installed measurement or selected rack budget.
Source: https://www.arista.com/en/qsg-7010-series-1ru/7010-series-1ru-overview
